VBO:0200416.summary: Friendly and even-tempered in the breed standard, the Rabbit Wire-haired Dachshund combines a persistent hunting focus with a keen nose. It works below ground and also gives voice, flushes and tracks above it. Germany’s Teckel club has organized Dachshund breeding since 1888.
VBO:0200416.shortDescription: A friendly, even-tempered rabbit-sized wire-haired Dachshund with a persistent hunting focus and keen nose.

sources.title: FCI Standard148 — Dachshund, nine maintained size/coat varieties
sources.evidence: Shared friendly/even temperament and persistent hunting nose; work below ground and above-ground giving tongue/flushing/tracking wounded game; DeutscheTeckelklub1888. Three sizes and three coats form nine varieties, Rabbit adult15month male27–32cm/female25–30cm chest. Literal wire harsh close dense coat/undercoat/beard/bushy brows/short ear hair/even close tail hair, wildboar blacknose;1.7–1.8body ratio/one-third clearance/real long muzzle/rounded mobile ears/normal muscular short legs/paws/full low tail slight last-third curve.
